outcomes.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.

nodes.question: To what extent has the image been transformed into a chalk drawing? Assess whether chalk-like drawn marks and texture are consistently realized across the main subjects and setting, or are only begun or unevenly applied; cite specific regions and any residual photographic qualities.
nodes.criteria: complete: chalk-like drawing treatment is consistently evident across the main subjects and setting, with drawn/chalk texture and marks replacing photographic rendering throughout. partial: visible progress toward a chalk drawing, but the treatment is uneven, limited to some regions, or substantial photographic rendering remains elsewhere. absent: no visible progress toward a chalk drawing. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress or completion. Judge style transformation only; do not require preservation of the original scene. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
nodes.binding: Target: the image. Reference: a drawing made from chalk.

program.checker_template: Execute exactly the supplied visual check on the source and edited images. Follow its saved binding, criteria and dependency evidence. Do not invent edits or infer an expected overall answer. Return JSON status, concise image-grounded evidence, and confidence (a number from 0 to 1, or null if unavailable). Confidence is your reported confidence in this check's observation, not a calibrated probability. A requested fulfillment check uses complete/partial/absent/unknown. A support check uses pass/fail/unknown. A known negative supporting observation can inform a requested check; it is not automatically uncertainty. Use unknown when the evidence cannot establish the requested fact. Do not count supporting facts as completed edits. Assess only the supplied check, not the overall instruction label.
